name: code-exercise
title: Code Exercise
description: Edit an exercise, run a sample and investigate a failing test.
usage: <CodeExercise draftKey="lesson:ids:v1" initialSource="^UI-[0-9]+$" tests={[{ input: "UI-23", expected: true }]} />
useCases: In a regex lesson, a student edits a pattern, checks it against sample strings and inspects mismatches.
In a lab, a student returns to an unfinished exercise. The app assigns each exercise its own draftKey so the right draft is restored.
task: Edit an exercise, run a sample and investigate a failing test.

models.TutorAnswer: type TutorAnswer = { text: string; citation?: Citation };

behavior: Use a distinct draftKey per lesson to persist drafts. A custom onExecute receives source, cases, an AbortSignal and onRunning. Return one boolean per case in input order.
